original_test_intent: Verify that Type 17 Extended Size is structurally present and authoritative only when legacy Size selects it, that its defined capacity bits and reserved bit are valid for each locator, and that the approved module capacity remains correct after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw Type 17 records and SMBIOS version; gate the Extended Size offset by structure length, require the legacy Size extended selector, preserve the raw 32-bit value, enforce reserved-bit rules, decode its defined MB capacity bits safely, compare trusted per-locator inventory and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves module capacity inventory and reboot plan. No DIMM change is required.
required_inputs: Expected capacity per locator whose legacy Size selects Extended Size
Applicable SMBIOS version and minimum Type 17 length
Exact legacy Size selector and inactive-field policy
Defined Extended Size capacity/reserved-bit and MB-to-byte rules
Raw-capable parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/inventory; do not add, remove or replace DIMMs.
Do not read the extended offset unless the formatted length includes it.
Treat Extended Size as authoritative only when the legacy Size selector requires it; preserve both raw fields.
Validate the reserved bit separately and normalize the defined capacity bits with overflow-safe arithmetic.
Stop on truncated selected field, invalid selector/reserved bit or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate field presence, legacy selector, raw extended bits/reserved bit, normalized per-locator capacity and pre/post reboot evidence.
Do not alter memory/firmware, infer inactive values or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve per-locator capacities and applicable selector/length/reserved-bit policy.
Approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The decoded Extended Size line is relevant, but grep -A1 cannot prove enclosing locator, field presence, legacy selector, raw reserved bit or units.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 17 data; report locator, structure length, raw legacy Size, selector decision, raw 32-bit Extended Size, reserved-bit state and normalized capacity.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Extended Size scope, Type 17 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing and memory changes are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Gate the field by Type 17 length, require the legacy Size selector, validate the raw reserved/capacity bits, normalize the defined MB value and compare trusted per-locator inventory before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 17 devices whose capacity uses the Extended Size representation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 17 Size selector and Extended Size layout/unit definitions plus authoritative module inventory.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds structure-length, raw selector coupling, reserved-bit validation and exact unit decoding.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects truncated/inactive fields, illegal selector combinations, reserved-bit corruption, unit errors and wrong-slot capacity.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Per-locator capacity and versioned representation rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The field represents device capacity metadata; it does not prove memory usability, training or addressability by the OS.

project_override_considerations: A project with devices representable in legacy Size should validate that field instead and explicitly mark Extended Size inactive; it must not require a duplicate extended value unless the governing specification/project policy does so.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/module identity, per-locator capacity and SMBIOS length/selector/reserved-bit policy
Per-device length, raw legacy selector, raw extended value, reserved-bit result and normalized capacity
Trusted module/SPD/asset capacity comparison tied to locator identity
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot raw plus semantic capacity diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Extended Size is complementary to legacy Size and has deterministic authority when the selector and structure length are evaluated.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Selector/bitfield decoding and inventory comparison are fully automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds record identity, length, raw selector, reserved bit and exact unit handling.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains version-aware capacity controls while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Defines safe inactive-field handling and keeps final verdict engineer-owned.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible decoded Extended Size from passing when the field is inactive, truncated, reserved-bit-invalid or attached to the wrong locator.
independent_technical_reasoning: The field has a deterministic raw selector, layout and unit; software can exhaustively validate it against approved per-device inventory.
